title: Your First Week Checkpoint
devotional: You have reached the end of your first week. This is not a test of whether you have been perfect. It is a moment to stop and look honestly at what you have learned. What situations made you vulnerable? What thoughts appeared before temptation? What changes helped you create distance? Growth often begins with awareness. When you allow God to examine your heart, you can begin to see patterns that were difficult to notice before. Don't use this checkpoint to condemn yourself. Use it to become more honest, more prepared, and more dependent on God.
mind_check: What have you learned about your thoughts, emotions, or patterns during the first six days?
body_move: Choose one physical or environmental change that helped you this week and commit to continuing it.
spirit_move: Spend a few quiet minutes asking God to show you one area where He wants you to grow next.
way_out: One pattern I now recognize is __________. My next step is __________.
prayer: Father, thank You for bringing me through this first week. Search my heart and show me the patterns I need to recognize. Help me learn from my mistakes without living in shame. Give me wisdom to keep making better choices and strength to continue walking with You. Amen.
action: Review Days 1-6. Write down three things you learned, one pattern you discovered, and one practical change you will carry into Week 2.
